pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi karonti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi karissanti seyyathāpi gihiniyo kāmabhoginiyoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi karissantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.8: athakho tā bhikkhuniyo bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.12: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi karontīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.15: hi nāma bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi karissanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.17: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.18.1: na udake uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:1.19: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhunīnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:2.1: tena kho pana samayena gilānā bhikkhuniyo udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi kātuṃ kukkuccāyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:2.3: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānāya bhikkhuniyā udake uccārampi passāvampi kheḷampi kātuṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:2.4: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:2.5.1: na udake agilānā uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karissāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:2.6: na udake agilānāya uccāro vā passāvo vā kheḷo vā kātabbo
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk75:2.7: yā anādariyaṃ paṭicca udake agilānā uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā karoti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
